Two problems: (1) The load pointer lacks tl.max_contiguous/tl.multiple_of hints, so the compiler cannot prove alignment and emits scalar 32-bit loads instead of 128-bit vectorized loads — this directly causes L1TEX scoreboard stalls at 50% of all cycles. (2) The store writes with an inner stride of 3 (y0 cycles 0..2 across YBLOCK=8 rows while x threads write 3*x2), causing 23% excess sectors. Adding vectorization hints on the load side enables 128-bit (float4) loads, reducing memory transactions by 4x and cutting L1TEX stall cycles. Additionally, autotuning XBLOCK/YBLOCK/num_warps/num_stages explores configurations that improve occupancy beyond the current 0.74 waves/SM.
